gunners.name: Wild Miner
gunners.note: Original client mob 102 (base/mobs.udf: Mob Wildminer, default-weapon 304 AK 47). The 2008-2011 manual lists melee mutants only; the count among mob_count and the ammunition supply are emulator policy. Level, HP and armour follow the band like the melee mutants; shots use ordinary AK 47 rules.

mutant_ai_note: Local policy, not recovered original server AI: individual sight and patrols within six walkable steps of each initial spawn. No respawn or shared enemy detection.
notes: Rates use 10000000 units/credit. The current exchange pays a fixed 50 credits per crystal. Past sales and quote samples retain their original rates.
